Job Title: Research Scientist (Psychologist) 
 
Job Category: Engineering 
 
Time Type: Full time 
 
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: Secret 
 
Employee Type: Regular 
 
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25% 
 
Type of Travel: Local 
 
 
* * * 
 

 The Opportunity: 

 CACI is seeking a Research Scientist (Psychologist) to plan, conduct, and analyze quantitative and mixed-methods experiments that evaluate human performance and perception with military electro-optical and infrared (EO/IR) sensor technology. You will design rigorous experiments, collect and analyze both objective performance data and subjective feedback, and communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Our client values a researcher who can translate complex data into evidence that informs the development of military technology. The position is onsite with periodic travel to support data collections and test events.

 Responsibilities: 

 As a seasoned technical individual contributor, you'll take ownership of your work and run with it, often with minimal oversight. You might lead projects or be asked to improve how things get done along the way. You'll also have the chance to mentor and support less experienced colleagues by reviewing their work and sharing what you've learned. You'll tackle challenges, sometimes tricky problems, and your ideas about system design, solutions, and procedures.

 Qualifications: 
 Required :
 Current secret security clearance
 PhD in Psychology or related field (developmental psychology, clinical psychology, etc.) from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education
 Desired Experience: At least three (3) years of experience in experimental or clinical research, which may include graduate or doctoral dissertation research
 Proficiency in R for statistical analysis and data management (required)
 Experience designing quantitative and mixed-methods research studies
 A record of peer-reviewed publications and presentations of research findings to diverse audiences
 Ability to travel multiple times per year for data collections and test events
 Ability to effectively communicate both orally and in writing

 Desired :
 Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation
 Experience with PsychoPy or similar experiment-building software
 Experience with Human Systems Integration (HSI), particularly for complex systems or military sensor equipment
 Experience designing and analyzing human perception experiments involving complex systems or military sensors
 Experience evaluating software user interfaces, especially video imagery with overlaid situational awareness information

 
 
- 
 
 What You Can Expect: 
  A culture of integrity. 
 At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.
 An environment of trust. 
 CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.
 A focus on continuous growth. 
 Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.
 
 

 Pay Range : 
 There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.
 
 The proposed salary range for this position is: 
$79,400 - $162,700 
 
 
 
 CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.
